title: version-pin-probe-scheduler-with-cost-throttling
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Implement a scheduler that automatically launches a series of lightweight and targeted eval probes when a model version is pinned or upgraded (both catalog-level promotions and tenant/customer pins). The scheduler should enforce a customer-configurable budget and global cost-throttles, prioritize probe types by risk profile (safety -> fidelity -> smoke), and integrate with the Console for visibility and rollback suggestions. Goal: catch regressions earlier while keeping incremental eval cost predictable and safe for multi-tenant deployments.
acceptance_criteria: 1) On a catalog or tenant version pin event the system starts a probe plan that matches tenant budget and risk tier. 2) Probe plan includes at least one safety check and one fidelity sampling against representative prompt shards. 3) Total eval token cost respects tenant budget and global throttles; excess is queued or sampled down. 4) Console shows probe status, sampled results, and a delta metric with baseline. 5) If any safety/fidelity thresholds are exceeded, the ticketing/alert path triggers a canary-hold recommendation and webhook to the tenant. 6) All probes produce traceable artifacts (PR links, screenshots, metric snapshots) and are stored for 90 days.
implementation_notes:
- Probe types: smoke (fast latency checks), fidelity (longer soft-metrics, BLEU/ROUGE/eval-specific), safety (classifier + rule-based heuristics).
- Sampling: tenant-aware shard sampling based on historical traffic and persona buckets; deterministic seed for reproducibility.
- Budgeting: per-tenant monthly eval credit + transient budget cap per-pin event. Global cost-throttle applies when platform spend hits a configured threshold.
- Backpressure: if capacity constrained, degrade fidelity probes first and queue safety until resources available (safety cannot be dropped entirely).
- Integration points: pin webhook -> eval-orchestrator -> probe-scheduler -> eval-runner -> results-store -> console.
- Observability: new Console panel with per-probe latency, token-cost, delta-to-baseline, and a small sparkline for drift.
- Rollback flow: auto-suggested rollback via the rollout service when fidelity delta > configured SLA and safety flag is tripped.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: runaway eval spend for tenants with frequent pins. Mitigation: enforce per-pin soft cap and require approval for over-budget runs.
- Risk: noisy deltas for low-traffic tenants. Mitigation: weighted sampling and minimum-sample floor; surface confidence intervals.
- Risk: blocking critical rollouts due to transient infra flakiness. Mitigation: automatic retry & fallback to cached baseline comparisons; mark infra failures separately from quality failures.
